unlisted_practices: Schema-constrained (JSON) output format to reduce parsing errors in LLM information extraction
Graded Likert-scale outputs with Youden-index threshold optimization to adjust detection sensitivity to clinical risk tolerance
Local deployment of open-source LLMs to avoid PHI transmission to external servers
Use of synthetic notes and hold-out prompt-development set for zero-shot prompt iteration

screen.reason: The paper provides a tutorial with an empirical demonstration evaluating local deployment design practices (JSON schema constraints to reduce errors and graded Likert scales with threshold optimization) for behavioral health note extraction on synthetic data.

primary.practice: schema-constrained structured outputs and threshold tuning
